neighbours.label: a quantity word that sets up a measure of something: ' amount', ' half', ' twice', ' lot'
fire: Farmers lost about half the crop during the long drought.
Only a small amount of rain fell over the valley in June.
This heater burns twice as much fuel as the older model.
Measure the exact amount of flour before you start baking.
The new pipeline will carry twice the oil of the old one.
We picked a lot of apples from the orchard last fall.
Nearly half of the water evaporates before reaching the fields.
The total amount of heat depends on the mass of the metal.
quiet: Farmers lost the crop during the long drought last year.
Only a small shower passed over the valley in June.
This heater burns cleaner fuel than the older model.
Measure the flour carefully before you start baking.
The new pipeline will carry oil from the northern fields.
We picked ripe apples from the orchard last fall.
Most of the water evaporates before reaching the fields.
The final temperature depends on the mass of the metal.
